caption: Select: switched on every kick between two ways of colouring - a sweep across and drifting noise
why: An effect with two behaviours needs a way to choose between them: a checkbox on the WLED page, a beat, a phase of a cycle. Select gives b when its switch is on and a when it is off - a fork in the graph.
Its neighbours: Mix fades smoothly between two values; Not flips the switch; Colour pick chooses among eight colours; Select is the hard switch between two numbers.
steps: **on** is a **Toggle** flipped by **Audio**'s beat: on for one kick, off for the next.
**a** is **Coords** `u` - a plain sweep of the palette. **b** is a **Noise** of `u` and `v` - blobs.
The result is the **Palette**'s index: on every kick the matrix swaps between the sweep and the blobs.
Wire a **Check 1** into on instead and the checkbox on the WLED page chooses.
